title: Groundhog Day
summary:
Top Reported Dirty Spot Charterers for 2016*
There were only minor changes in the rankings of the top dirty spot charterers in 2016 as compared to 2015. Unipec, Shell and Vitol claimed the top positions as they did last year. The Indian Oil Company and ExxonMobil each moved up one position, while Petrochina moved down two spots.
